# Shared scene contract
Do not edit core.js or the shell. Implement only your assigned scene files in dist/scenes/.
Each script uses an IIFE, setting window.SCENES[id] = () => cfg. Factory must return fresh state and scene closure. cfg accepted by shared mountFigure in ../core.js. It has title, hint, size:[W,D,H], state, scene(s,m), buttons:[{label,onClick(s,ui)}], acts:{name(s,el,ui)}, readout(s), idea, credit:false. Optional setup(ui) is invoked by shell after mount. ui.animate(dt=>boolean) renders max30fps and stops when false; ui.flash(text); ui.invalidate(). All UI Chinese. window.__st is exposed by renderer for QA.
Main model front face is x=max. Side y=max. z up. Typical dimensions 65×65×85. Reuse exact core material palette PALS, CERAMIC, METAL, DARK, matOf(hex), ink/shadows. No external libs/assets.
Primitive box(x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,material,tone,1); cyl(x,y,z0,z1,r,m); cylX(x0,x1,y,z,r,m); rod([x,y,z],[x,y,z],r,m); extrude(profileUV,x0,x1,m); shape(on(PX(x),rectUV(y0,z0,y1,z1)),fill,strokeWidth); tx(x,y,z,text,size,fill) is front-face text. on(PY(y),...) for side; txY exists. Read actual core.js for precise API. Geometry pieces depth sort via byDepth([{at:[x,y,z],svg:...}]); castShadow([...3D corners]) should precede object. Use act('name',svg,'role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="中文"') for physical clickable parts. Rotation and part clicks handled by shared mountFigure. Do not implement unrelated page designs.
Scene must be real volumetric geometry with layered materials, outlines, small screws/vents/feet/seams/material details. Not flat panels with emoji. Complete plausible state flow. Repeated clicks must not fork animations; reset invalidates existing animation with run token. No fake audio: WebAudio only after explicit user gesture; silent default with enable toggle. Audio stop on hidden document or reset/navigation. Do not write permanent RAF idle loops. Cache static geometry by [YAW,PITCH,s.pal] if beneficial. scene.layers optional for stable layer caching, see claw app.js.
Seven scenes share paper #faf8f2, ink #231e16, accent mint default, Chinese sans-serif, same shell. Parent handles controls/layout/navigation. Deliver code and testing steps with useful state checks and expected progression. No browser testing concurrently without coordinator approval.
